data.description:
## Context / Problem

`tests/unit/test_compact_all_selection.py::test_a_sweep_with_nothing_selected_still_pushes` is named for, and its docstring describes, the `Nothing to do.` early return in `compact_all_cli` (`src/rebar/_commands/compact.py`, the `total_needs == 0` branch that calls `_best_effort_push`). It never reaches that branch. `tests/conftest.py` sets `REBAR_COMPACTION_HORIZON_NS=0`, so the backfill arm selects the seeded snapshot-less ticket whatever `REBAR_COMPACT_THRESHOLD=9999` says; the sweep folds it and the fold path's own push satisfies `assert calls`.

Measured 2026-11-03 at `90d57e392ba` (session a85e3cd3, while working soldierly-arbitrary-hackee): with a scratch pytest plugin replacing `compact._best_effort_push` by a no-op, the test still PASSED. In the same setup, `compact_all_cli(["--dry-run"])` printed `Tickets needing compaction    : 1`, not `Nothing to do.`.

## Approach

Set `REBAR_COMPACTION_HORIZON_NS` to 1 hour in the test, as soldierly-arbitrary-hackee does for `test_dry_run_never_pushes` / `test_no_commit_never_pushes`, so fresh events are not foldable and nothing is selected; capture the exit status and assert it is 0 and that `Nothing to do.` is in stdout.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The test asserts exit 0 and `Nothing to do.` in captured stdout, and FAILS when `_best_effort_push` is replaced by a no-op.
data.title: Nothing-selected push test never reaches the early return
